changes: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/git-integration/explores/{exploreName}/file-path — api path removed without deprecation

declaredAdvisories.reason: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/git-integration/explores/{exploreName}/file-path is removed together with the edit-yaml-in-ui feature flag and the FeatureFlags.EditYamlInUi enum member; the already-deprecated explore files and file-change PR endpoints are removed in the same change. The endpoint refused callers unless that flag was on, and the flag was off by default on Cloud and on self-hosted. Callers now get a 404 and should use the /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/git branch and file endpoints instead.

impact.firstPartyOnly: The Lightdash web app source code editor drawer was the only client, and it is removed in the same change. During a rolling update an old browser tab with the drawer open from Explore shows an error resolving the file path until refresh, which is safe because the drawer only read files and the error does not affect any other page.
